Newsletters and circulars

Find newsletters with information about NZQA processes and requirements

NZQA's newsletters and circulars give schools and education providers up to date information, as they need it.

Find out more about each newsletter below.

Searching for newsletters

On each newsletter page you can use the search bar to find the newsletter you want.

Try searching by:

  • date (day, month and year)
  • terms and phrases in the title of the newsletter
  • reference numbers.

You can also filter the newsletters by different tags.

On this page

Assessment Matters

This newsletter is for schools and education providers who assess National Certificates of Educational Achievement (NCEA) and other secondary qualifications.

It includes important information about assessing standards and running assessment and moderation.
